verdict.rationale: Gusto is a payroll/HR SaaS and embedded-payroll API platform, not an AI agent or tool-execution engine that itself consumes external MCP servers. The only MCP-related evidence shows Gusto publishing an MCP *server* so external AI tools (Cursor, Claude Desktop) can call Gusto's API—the opposite direction from the story, which asks whether Gusto can plug in MCP servers to use their tools. This axis is a category mismatch for a payroll platform's product role.
